explanation: Always true, serves as a base rule.
If you dont have logs, planks or sticks, mine logs
If you have logs but no planks, craft planks
If you have 4 planks, arent near a crafting table, or dont have a crafting table, craft a crafting table
If you have a crafting table, have a plank, are not near a crafting table, place the crafting table
If you have 3 planks, 2 sticks, are near a crafting table, and dont have a wooden pickaxe, craft a wooden pickaxe
If you have 3 cobblestone, 2 sticks, are near a crafting table, and dont have a stone pickaxe, craft a stone pickaxe
If you have 8 cobblestone, are near a crafting table, dont have a furnace and are not near a furnace, craft a furnace
If you have three iron ore, are near a furnace, have fuel and do not have either of an iron pickaxe or 3 iron ingots, smelt iron
If you have 3 iron ingots, 2 sticks, are near a crafting table, and dont have an iron pickaxe, craft an iron pickaxe
If you have an iron pickaxe and the iron pickaxe is not equipped, equip the iron pickaxe
If the iron pickaxe is equipped, and you have diamonds near you, mine the diamond
If you dont have diamonds in the chunk, and you have your iron pickaxe equipped, explore downwards for diamonds
If you either have diamonds near you, or you dont have an iron pickaxe equipped, dont explore for diamonds
If you dont have a wood pickaxe, a stone pickaxe, or an iron pickaxe equipped, do not mine stone
If you dont have a stone pickaxe, or an iron pickaxe equipped, do not mine iron ore
If you dont have 8 cobblestone, dont craft a furnace
If you dont have a wood pickaxe, a stone pickaxe, or an iron pickaxe equipped, do not mine coal
If you dont have any of 3 planks, 2 sticks, or arent near a crafting table, or if you already have a wood pickaxe, then dont craft a wooden pickaxe.
If you dont have any of 3 cobblestone, 2 sticks, or arent near a crafting table, or if you already have a stone pickaxe, then dont craft a stone pickaxe.
If you dont have any of 3 iron ingots, 2 sticks, or arent near a crafting table, or if you already have a iron pickaxe, then dont craft a iron pickaxe.
